The *Satilakkhaṇapañha* ("The Question on Mindfulness", Mil 3.1.13) is a section of the *Milindapañha* devoted to defining the characteristic of mindfulness (*sati*). The text is available in several modern languages, including an English translation by John Kelly.

Passages are also shared with canonical and post-canonical works, including the *Tikanipāta* (AN 3), the *Mahādhammasamādāna Sutta* (MN 46), the *Bojjhaṅga Saṁyutta* (SN 46), the *Tikapuggalapaññatti* (Pp 2.3), the *Hārasampātabhūmi* of the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 8), and the *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, the text shares recurring structural and interrogative formulas with adjacent chapters of the *Milindapañha*, such as the *Sampasādanalakkhaṇasaddhāpañha* (Mil 3.1.10), the *Sampakkhandanalakkhaṇasaddhāpañha* (Mil 3.1.11), the *Vīriyalakkhaṇapañha* (Mil 3.1.12), and the *Paññālakkhaṇapañha* (Mil 3.1.15) [DharmaNexus].
